service.description: The scope Home's projections share: an organization of the caller's marketing scope, or none for each of them.

Home's MarketingCards for the organization named or each of the caller's: one card per source (running campaigns, pending approvals, sends due, failed or uncertain deliveries, registrations against capacity, audience changes), each with its cardKey, title, state (available with its value and linkPath; notAvailable until its phase builds its records, never zero; failed when it could not be read) and message; failedSources names each that failed, the others still answered. Refuses a caller who reads nothing of Marketing (PERMISSION_DENIED) and an organization outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED).

Home's Upcoming: the planned activity of the organization named or each of the caller's (campaign windows, scheduled sends, events and approved publication dates of the next 60 days, the last two the campaign calendar's sources, MarketingCalendar.js), rows of kind, title, date, zone, state, owner and linkPath merged by date, and each source's state (notAvailable until its phase, failed when it could not be read; failedSources names those). Refuses as get#Home.

Home's Attention: the exceptions to resolve, rows of sourceKey, recordKind, record, reason, age, action and its place as a route key (route); P1's source is the campaigns, lists and segments awaiting adoption, a Marketing administrator's (MARKETING_CONFIGURE), counted by kind; approvals (P2) and deliveries (P9) are notAvailable until built. Each source's state as get#Upcoming. Refuses as get#Home.

The SettingsIndex: the Marketing settings built so far, each with entryKey, title, description, category, owner, its place as a route key (route) and its readiness text; P1 the adoption of unowned records. Refuses a caller without MARKETING_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED).

Marketing's setup readiness, answering the framework's readiness contract (moqui.server.ReadinessProvider marketing.setup) with no adapter: called with providerKey and an organizationPartyId of the caller's scope (or none), returns checks of checkKey, title, state (ready, warning, failed or unavailable), reasonCode, message, subject and scope, and for a check that is not ready its place as a route key (fixRoute): P1 the campaigns, lists and segments that belong to no organization and await adoption (marketingAdoption), which are no organization's and so checked once. Later phases add theirs. One check that fails is unavailable by name and the others go on. Changes nothing. Refuses a caller without MARKETING_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED) and an organization outside their scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED).

A party's engagement with the caller's organizations (Customer360's Engagement tab in Marketing's context; MarketingEngagement.js): its campaigns (MARKETING_VIEW, each from a source below the caller may read), list and segment memberships, sends with their delivery, observed opens and clicks only while the party allows tracking in the send's organization, and consent (MARKETING_AUDIENCE_VIEW), form answers without their text (MARKETING_AUDIENCE_VIEW or MARKETING_REPORT_VIEW), event registrations without order or payment (MARKETING_EVENT_MANAGE) and promotion use without the order (COMMERCE_VIEW and Commerce's store scope). Each source answers only with its own permission: one without it is left out and named in omittedSources, never answered as zero; each reads only the organizations of the caller's scope (or the one named), and one that fails is named in failedSources while the others answer. Refuses a caller who reads nothing of Marketing (PERMISSION_DENIED), an organization outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED) and a missing party or another user's personal contact (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

service.description: The campaign schedule of the organization named or each of the caller's from start to end (days yyyy-MM-dd in the user's time zone, at most 400; MarketingCalendar.js): campaign windows, scheduled sends, automation milestones (for a reader of automations), approved publication dates (a campaign's blog post with a published page, its landing page live or scheduled) and the events Marketing offers (a registration event of an organization of the scope or an event linked to one of its campaigns, each instance in the range). Each item: kind (campaign, send, automation, publication or event), key, title, stateText, recordKind, recordId, recordParameter, route (a route key), organizationPartyId, allDay, startText and endText (an all-day item's first day and the day after its last; a timed one's wall-clock times), startMillis and endMillis (a timed one), and for an event workEffortId, seriesWorkEffortId, recurring and instanceStart. Only an event is ever moved, through the calendar's own update#EventOccurrence; the rest is read only. Each source on its own: one that fails is named in failedSources and the others answer. No recipient, address or token. Refuses a caller who reads nothing of Marketing (PERMISSION_DENIED), an organization outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED) and a range that is not two days in order (DATES_INVALID).

Whether an event is one the caller's campaign calendar holds (a registration event of an organization of the scope, or an event linked to one of its campaigns), the one kind of item the calendar moves (through the calendar's own update#EventOccurrence, which decides who may change it). Refuses anything else, a send among them, as not available (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), and a caller who reads nothing of Marketing (PERMISSION_DENIED).

The "Campaign calendar", a projected CalDAV collection (MarketingSeedData.xml's CalendarProjection MarketingCampaigns; the projected kind of mantle.work.CalendarDavServices, read only: a device write is refused): admitted for a holder of MARKETING_VIEW; without checkOnly the items of get#CalendarItems for the organizations of the caller's scope from start through end (epoch millis; 30 days back to 180 ahead when none) as the ICalendar tool's event maps, each titled by its kind and name with its state. No recipient, address or token.

Marketing's part of the user's Today, for the organizations of their scope: the sends due by the end of today or sending (an author, approver or dispatcher), the approvals awaiting a decision (an approver), the sends released in the last 30 days with a failed or uncertain delivery (a dispatcher; counts) and the offers still to come with registrations waiting for the organizer (an events manager; a count per offer), each with sourceKey, kind, title, dueDate, recordKind, recordId, recordParameter, recordEntity, recordName and its place as a route key (route). Each source on its own: one that fails is named in failedSources and the others answer. None for a user who reads nothing of Marketing; no recipient, attendee, address or token.

parameter.description: The end of the day (the start of tomorrow when none)
